Descriptions.Text: Different effects stack. Re-applying the same row while it is active is refused: the running effect is not refreshed.
Stacks like None. While any effect of this category is active, every category 10002 effect is suspended; they resume when the last one ends. Unused in vanilla.
The same row can be applied again and again: each application adds another instance.
Re-applying the same row replaces the running instance and restarts its timer. Different rows stack.
A new effect replaces an existing one of this category with the same Category Priority. Different priorities coexist.
One per category: a new effect replaces the existing effect of this category in place (it takes the new row and its timer restarts).
